key: SOE Estimator (Adaptive Kalman Filter, Variable Energy Capacity)
title: SOE Estimator (Adaptive Kalman Filter, Variable Energy Capacity)
text: 使用卡尔曼滤波器和可变能量容量的能量状态与端子电阻估计器，输入 6 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Specify Current input as cell current(s)} 指定将电流输入端口指定为向量、{Filter type} 指定卡尔曼滤波器类型 Extended Kalman、{Alpha}、{Beta}、{Kappa}、{Covariance of the process noise, Q} 指定过程噪声的协方差、{Covariance of the measurement noise, R} 指定测量噪声的协方差、{Initial state error covariance, P0} 指定初始状态误差协方差、{Charge dynamics} 用于对电池充电动态建模的选项 One time-constant、{Vector of state-of-energy values, SOE (-)} 指定 SOE 断点、{Vector of temperatures, T} 指定温度断点、{First polarization resistance, R1(SOE,T), (ohm)} 指定温度断点处的第一 RC 电阻、{First time constant, tau1(SOE,T), (s)} 指定温度断点处的第一 RC 时间常数、{Second polarization resistance, R2(SOE,T), (ohm)} 指定温度断点处的第二 RC 电阻、{Second time constant, tau2(SOE,T), (s)} 指定温度断点处的第二 RC 时间常数、{No-load voltage, V0(SOE,T), (V)} 指定 V 0 查找表、{Algorithm data type} 用于选择模块算法数据类型的选项 Inherit，按实例取值。

params.name: Specify Current input as cell current(s)
params.values: 将电流输入端口指定为向量的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Filter type
params.values: 卡尔曼滤波器类型 Extended Kalman filter (default) | Extended Kalman-Bucy filter | Unscented Kalman filter | Unscented Kalman-Bucy filter

params.name: Alpha
params.values: Alpha 系数 1 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Kappa
params.values: Kappa 系数 0 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 3]

params.name: Covariance of the process noise, Q
params.values: 过程噪声的协方差 [1e-6 0 0; 0 1e-6 0;0 0 1e-6] (default) | matrix of scalars

params.name: Covariance of the measurement noise, R
params.values: 测量噪声的协方差 0.1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Initial state error covariance, P0
params.values: 初始状态误差协方差 [1e-5 0 0; 0 1 0; 0 0 1e-5] (default) | matrix of scalars

params.name: Charge dynamics
params.values: 用于对电池充电动态建模的选项 One time-constant dynamics (default) | Two time-constant dynamics

params.name: Vector of state-of-energy values, SOE (-)
params.values: SOE 断点 [0,.1,.25,.5,.75,.9, 1] (default) | vector of scalars in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Vector of temperatures, T
params.values: 温度断点 [278, 293, 313] (default) | vector of positive scalars

params.name: Algorithm data type
params.values: 用于选择模块算法数据类型的选项 Inherit: auto (default) | double | single |
